In the Revelation Mountains of Alaska, Marty faces off with a vicious wolverine. In Montana, Rich tries to protect a young family from a hungry predator.
As the bitter cold pushes predators to the edge, Tom is caught in a close-range battle while Rich goes head to head with a pack of wolves.
A visit from Tom's son Chad goes terribly wrong and Marty's flight back from the Revelation Mountains is delayed.
Cyril is trapped underwater while on a mission to catch huge flat-headed beasts hiding in the murky snake and alligator-infested rivers of Texas and Mississippi.

Cyril explores the Bolivian jungle to visit the river where a violent underwater attack happened to a tribesman. He goes on a mission to find out what kind of monster fish could be the culprit of such a violent attack.
Cyril tries to catch a fish that can weigh more than a thousand pounds.
After swimming out of a dangerous current, Cyril explores the Indian Ocean with local fishermen.
Cyril fights off deadly bear attacks and menacing wolves as he goes to the edge of the Arctic into uncharted territory. Plus, he hears terrifying tales of massive fish ripping apart fishermen's nets.
Marty is stranded in the Revelation Mountains with one last chance to get home, while Kyle and Ben launch a nighttime stakeout to stop a predator.
Tom battles a dangerous ice jam. Marty launches a last-ditch escape from the Revelations, and a deadly predator returns to the Ruby Valley.
Marty is forced to make a mid-flight detour that costs him precious fuel; Rich faces his worst fear when the dogs run off in pursuit of a deadly predator, and Kyle takes down a beast.
Relive the mountain men's best battles against nature's deadliest predators.
After surviving last year's record-breaking cold, the Mountain Men return more prepared than ever to do battle against Mother Nature.
The Whalers refuse to haul the expeditions fuel any further North. The men must calculate if they have enough fuel and food to make it. The ocean begins to freeze right beneath the men’s watercraft.

The ice pack moves in around the fuel boat and all the Jet Ski Watercraft. Gasoline barrels rupture, the team all hunker down on the fuel boat, the weather moves in. The team must make their most difficult decision ever before someone gets hurt.
For the first time ever the crew of Dangerous Waters round table the expeditions adventure this season and talk about some of the things that happened behind the scenes.
